form: SCALAR for every client in this group: each client reads several banks in ONE edge and needs their answers together (COLL ctl assembles bank pairs; gather master QBG reads 4 banks/ring/edge; host QDQ reads 4 consecutive banks). The die pads the short banks' REQUEST lanes (17 b per bank) to the budget, never the 257-b response lanes.
uniform_over_quadrants: the four gather masters run ONE symmetric timeline (ot_hgi_coll_gq header), so all quadrants take the slowest quadrant's budget; one hardened view per master
rule: share BANK_RT = 6 + faces pin 1 + lane(rq) + lane(rr) (equal over 8 banks after pads); client VM_RT = BANK_RT - 6 + face_extra (0 REG0 share, 2 REG1 leaf_r) + client<->share lanes (rq+rr, equal over the 4 bank pairs after pads); QDQ RL = 7 + same excess

hcollrs_NE/NW/SE/SW.die_pads: every bank's rq lane to round trip 72 (pad_b = 72 - RT_b)

hb_coll_NE/NW/SE/SW.die_pads: COLL<->hcollrs lanes to 8 edges total (REG0 share) or 6 (REG1 leaf_r)
hb_coll_NE/NW/SE/SW.rtl: fork branch claude/hbm-banklat-collctl-1019 (ctl_v5 critical: coordinator review)

hb_idx__nwsh.die_pads: every NW bank's rq3 lane to round trip 40

hb_quant_NW.die_pads: hb_quant_NW<->nwsh lanes to 4 total (REG0) / 2 (REG1): RL = 7 + 34 + face_extra + lanes = 45

hb_idx__op_NW.note: behind nwsh: share excess at budget = 34 (+2 face extra if REG1); VM_RT_EXTRA = 4 + 34 + extra + lanes - 2

headroom: hcollrs 72 vs GEN2c 68 (+4), nwsh 40 vs 36 (+4), client lanes padded to 8/4. GEN2d (ring blocks beside the VM banks) is expected to SHORTEN these lanes; the die pads up to the budget, so the hardened views need not change. A later re-harden at a smaller budget is a pure latency gain (each gather +74 edges at this budget; COLL VM reads +74).
cost: gather master: +74 x (event 11 b + rd expectation 8 b + fire 1 b) flops + ld_desc from held state; share2: owner pipeline 4 b x (BANK_RT-6) per leaf; die: request-lane pads 17 b per bank per padded edge.
